description: Tata Textile Mills Limited was incorporated in Pakistan on 15 April 1987 and started production at a 19,200-spindle spinning unit in 1991. It manufactures and sells cotton and blended yarn at manufacturing facilities in Karachi, Kotri and Muzaffargarh, and its registered office is on the sixth floor of Textile Plaza, M.A. Jinnah Road, Karachi. From 1 July 2021 it absorbed the group's Island Textile Mills Limited, Salfi Textile Mills Limited and Tata Energy Limited through a merger approved by the Sindh High Court.
headOffice: 6th Floor, Textile Plaza, M.A. Jinnah Road, Karachi 74000, Pakistan
